extras.what: an authored crack texture in the pack, overriding the game's by filename
extras.why: Mineclonia's crack_anylength.png is 16 by 160 (ten 16 px stages), and draw_crack scales one stage over the 256 px base, so a damaged block shows 16 px cracks on a 256 px face
extras.note: not a node tile, so the census cannot rank it; every block a player digs shows it

rework_known_failures.why: These eleven ship. Each fails one rule, surface is too smooth for its material class, by between 0.3 and 27 per cent of a band the classification review itself describes as the pipeline's defaults rather than a per texture judgement. The five soil ones are the authored path's keep_mean clipping at zero and so lifting the mean it was setting; the rails, the torch and the grass top are near misses or a class derived from a footstep sound. Rejecting them would leave dirt, clay, podzol and rails with no maps beside neighbours that have them, which is a worse picture than the overshoot.
